title: flywheel: orch_remediate input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_remediate instead; removed in v4.0] Apply the canonical fix for a failing doctor check. Default mode is dry_run; pass mode:'execute' + autoConfirm:true to actually mutate. Per-check mutex prevents concurrent calls.

checkName.description: The doctor check name to remediate

autoConfirm.description: Required to be true when mode=execute and the remediation is mutating

mode.description: dry_run=return plan only, execute=apply the fix
